items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: He'd say... 'I know a guy over here, Martin, he's got a club over here on the plaza... I know him pretty well.'

ctx.x: So well, he'd always have something to do, you know. He'd say -- I'd say, "Well, Mr. Bales, what are you doing?" He'd say, "Well, I don't know. Maybe we'll get together and run over a few tunes this evening." "Okay." So then he told me, he says, "You know, everybody kind of liked you over there. They liked you pretty good. So I know a guy over here, Martin, he's got a club over here on the plaza. There's never been no colored musicians in there, but I know him pretty well. Now, if you want to get a group…
